req.title: Cookies domain restriction
req.statement: The system shall not include cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host when responding to /cookies.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /cookies must NOT include cookies whose Domain attribute excludes the request host. The Flask test client sends cookies via the Cookie header directly; the view_cookies handler reads request.cookies which only contains cookies the browser would send (i.e., domain-matched ones). We test: (1) positive — cookies sent in the Cookie header appear in the response JSON; (2) negative — a cookie NOT sent in the Cookie header (simulating domain exclusion) does NOT appear; (3) boundary — exactly zero cookies yields an empty dict; (4) additional positive — multiple cookies all appear with exact values; (5) DT — cookie present in header vs absent covers both sides of the domain-restriction decision.

tests.name: test_cookies_positive_matching_cookie_appears
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
A cookie named 'session' with value 'abc123' is sent in the Cookie header
actions: GET /cookies with Cookie header containing session=abc123
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_cookies_positive_matching_cookie_appears():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'session=abc123'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'session': 'abc123'}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1

test_cookies_positive_matching_cookie_appears()

No Cookie header is sent (simulating domain-excluded cookie)
expected: Cookie dict is empty — domain-excluded cookie is absent

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_cookies_negative_absent_cookie_not_in_response():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 0
    assert 'excluded_cookie' not in data['cookies']

test_cookies_negative_absent_cookie_not_in_response()

def test_cookies_boundary_exactly_zero_cookies():

    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.content_type == 'application/json'
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert data == {'cookies': {}}

tests.name: test_cookies_positive_multiple_cookies_all_present
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Multiple cookies sent in Cookie header
actions: GET /cookies with Cookie header containing foo=bar and baz=qux
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_cookies_positive_multiple_cookies_all_present():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'foo=bar; baz=qux'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies']['foo'] == 'bar'
    assert data['cookies']['baz'] == 'qux'
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 2
    assert data['cookies'] == {'foo': 'bar', 'baz': 'qux'}

test_cookies_positive_multiple_cookies_all_present()

tests.name: test_cookies_dt_domain_excluded_cookie_absent_domain_included_present
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
One cookie is sent (domain-matched), one is NOT sent (domain-excluded)
actions: GET /cookies with only the domain-matched cookie in the Cookie header
Verify domain-excluded cookie name is absent from response
expected: JSON cookies contains only the sent cookie with exact value
Domain-excluded cookie key is not present in response cookies
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_cookies_dt_domain_excluded_cookie_absent_domain_included_present():
    client = app.test_client()
    # Only send 'included_cookie'; 'excluded_cookie' is never sent (domain mismatch)
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'included_cookie=hello'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert 'included_cookie' in data['cookies']
    assert data['cookies']['included_cookie'] == 'hello'
    assert 'excluded_cookie' not in data['cookies']
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1

test_cookies_dt_domain_excluded_cookie_absent_domain_included_present()

tests.name: test_cookies_boundary_single_cookie_exact_value
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: GET /cookies with exactly one cookie: k=v
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_cookies_boundary_single_cookie_exact_value():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'k=v'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    assert data['cookies'] == {'k': 'v'}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1
    assert data['cookies']['k'] == 'v'
    # Ensure no extra keys leaked in
    assert list(data.keys()) == ['cookies']

test_cookies_boundary_single_cookie_exact_value()
